action.expected_information: Host verification of whether g_18(0) equals the global minimum; this checks existence without asserting that every optimum is balanced.

skeptic.summary: EV002 exactly verifies that a balanced global minimizer exists at n=18, with optimum energy 25. The complete profile also reports unbalanced optima at b=2 and b=6, refuting the distinct all-optima balance claim at n=18.
skeptic.limitation: Verification applies only to n=18 and establishes no general theorem. Balanced-only search preserves the optimum value here but excludes some global minimizers.
skeptic.next_question: Is the intended search required to find one global minimizer or enumerate all global minimizers?
